B also adds tests for the Retry-After header, the report text and the TTL minimum and boundaries. Those are exactly the spots where a missed conversion would otherwise slip through, and B checked that the new tests pass on the original code. A only points out that these spots are untested. B's new exported MS_PER_SECOND constant and its inSeconds helper are small extras, not real problems.

The private inSeconds helper in report.ts is a minor abstraction for just two uses.
